item.title: Livingston County Commission
item.description: The Livingston County Commission meets in regular session today at the Livingston County Courthouse. The meeting starts at 9:30 am in the commission room. The agenda includes county road and bridge matters and administrative and departmental responsibilities. The public is welcome to attend County Commission meetings.

item.title: Kentucky Man Arrested By Troopers
item.description: A Kentucky man was arrested in Linn County on Wednesday night. State Troopers arrested 26-year-old Myron J. Sommers of Russellville, KY, at about 9:43 pm for alleged Driving While Intoxicated. Sommers was taken to the Brookfield Police Department, processed, and released.
